# pbs_version (Data Source)

Reports the version of the Proxmox Backup Server the provider is connected to. Every user and API token may read it, without any ACL entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_version" "this" {}

# Stop early when the server is older than a feature needs.
check "pbs_is_recent" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_version.this.major > 4 || (data.pbs_version.this.major == 4 && data.pbs_version.this.minor >= 2)
    error_message = "This configuration needs PBS 4.2 or newer; the server runs ${data.pbs_version.this.version}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `major` (Number) Major version, such as `4`. Null when the version does not parse.
- `minor` (Number) Minor version, such as `2`. Null when the version does not parse.
- `release` (Number) Release within the minor version, such as `8`. Null when the version does not parse.
- `repoid` (String) Git commit the release was built from.
- `version` (String) Full version, such as `4.2.8`.
